newsitem.title: CHINA: Typhoon Victor kills 45 in China paper.
newsitem.headline: Typhoon Victor kills 45 in China paper.

text.p: At least 45 people were killed, hundreds injured and nearly 1.7 million affected when Typhoon Victor swept across southern China last weekend, a Hong Kong newspaper said on Tuesday.
The South China Morning Post said more than 10,000 homes collapsed in the powerful typhoon, which earlier slammed into Hong Kong, where it left one dead and 50 or so injured.
Chinese officials quoted by the newspaper said damage to farms and fields was estimated at 4.8 billion yuan (US$580 million).
Air, land and sea traffic ground to a halt when Victor swept across Hong Kong on Saturday, the most powerful typhoon to hit the city in 14 years.
